{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == 999999.99]
print('QA orders found:', len(qa_orders))

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'refunded']
print('Refunded orders found:', len(refunded_orders))

# Cross-tabulate customer_segment vs customer_age (to check for confounding)
print('\nCross-tabulation of customer_segment vs customer_age (where age == -1):')
print(pd.crosstab(sales['customer_segment'], sales['customer_age'] == -1))"}
